name: Following the money
prompt: A subpoena brings back a year of bank records for a car wash the crew's head owns. The deposits are larger than its customers.

choices.text: Go through the deposits line by line

outcome.told: By the end of the night you have a table of cash deposits just under the reporting line.
She shows you the second set of books before her lawyer arrives.

failure.told: She calls a lawyer before you sit down, and the head knows by evening what you asked.
